interpretation: Open numbered-room junctions have no added physical wall. These mask partitions extend the verified architectural wall lines; they are documented texture ownership rules. Existing other-stop masks are preserved.

boundary_filter_policy: At triangles crossing a plane, retain a texel only when all four pixel-square corners mapped affinely through the original triangle lie inside the allowed rectangle. Fully inside triangles remain addressable. Union of forbidden coverage vetoes shared edge pixels.
limitations: Finite8192 binary masks leave a conservative boundary strip up to a texel footprint. Use nearest-neighbour mask sampling at native resolution. A source surface ID may be partially selected; the mask is authoritative, not a whole-ID switch. No mesh/UV changes are needed.
